summary:
The KOTK-2017 ground roster: which items reach the floor, in what relative share, in how big a stack, and the two boxes that flank every gun. The client ships NO loot table at all (S8 s5.1), so the roster and the shares are the owner's own and cross under D53. The 168,322 marker POSITIONS, the item ids, the ground models and the clip sizes in the same file are the client's and are not rulings.

PER-ITEM WEIGHTS ARE NOT DUPLICATED HERE. All 79 rows live in tools/data/gen-loot-tables.py's TABLES and ship inside z2-loot-tables.json, which tools/pipeline/manifest.json already grades CLIENT+RULING with its own sha256. Copying 79 weights into this file would create a second source of truth with nothing to keep them equal. Instead this file records the roster's SHAPE - per-category entry count and total weight - and tools/pipeline/generators/gen-rulings.py CROSS-CHECKS every one of those numbers against the checked-in z2-loot-tables.json at generate time and fails if they have drifted.

rows.note: Cross-checked against z2-loot-tables.json at generate time.
